title.narrative: In 2025, UNICEF Maldives advanced strategic communication, advocacy, resource mobilization, and partnerships, enhancing visibility, influencing policy, and securing new partnerships. Through inclusive storytelling, youth engagement, and high-level alliances, UNICEF strengthened its positioning and contributed to programmatic and office-wide achievements to advance children's rights, despite capacity constraints and evolving global funding dynamics.
